product_metadata.title: Furmax 24" Dining Chair Set of 2 Modern PU Leather Chair Kitchen Living Room Chair Counter Height Upholstered Bar Stool, Backless and Armless Side Chair with Solid Metal Legs (Grey)
features: 【Modern PU Leather】The chair is crafted with skin friendly high-quality PU leather and high-resilience & high-density thicker sponge which offer you more comfortable meal time.PU leather is waterproof and dirt resistant, easy to clean and has long daily service life.

【Sturdy Metal Base】The chair base and legs are made of black powder-coated solid premium steel, avoid it to rust and bend over a long period of use. The footrest are welded to each leg by 4 contact points at each leg for added rigidity.

【Attentive Design】The footrest provide a resting place for your feet and the foot pads of the chair are non-slip and wear-resistant, which can effectively protect your floor from being scratched, and keep quiet when moving. The foot pad can adjust the height of the chair legs to keep the chair balanced.

【Easily Assemble】This dining chair is easy to been assembled, following the instructions, you only need to spend 15 minutes to complete these 2 dining chairs. The simple and elegant design of the chair is perfect for your living room, dining room and kitchen.
【Product Dimension】Overall dimension: 20.5"L x 15.5"W x 24"H. Seat dimension: 19"L x 14"W. Height of the footrest: 9.5". Maximum load: 280 pounds.
